inlines.v: BISH'OPRIC, noun [bishop and ric, jurisdiction.] 1. A diocese; the district over which the jurisdiction of bishop extends. in England, are twenty-four bishoprics, besides that of Sodor and Man; in Ireland, eighteen. 2. The charge of instructing and governing in spiritual concerns; office. Acts 1:20.
